ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Closed`. The lamp starts off (`lamp = false` from its declaration).
The door opens: `Closed` to `Open` fires, and entering `Open` runs its entry action, `lamp = true`. The transition itself has no effect.
`doorOpen` is still true (inputs keep their value). `Open` has nothing to do, so `lamp` stays true.
The door closes: leaving `Open` runs its exit action, `lamp = false`.
Open again: the entry action runs again, as it does on every entry.
